description: This file defines an interface ITypeManifestProvider and an abstract class TypeManifestProviderBase related to providing type manifest information and configuration in the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: TypeManifestProviderBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for generated type manifest providers, implementing ITypeManifestProvider and providing configuration logic.

methods.name: ConfigureInner
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to configure the TypeManifestOptions.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Property returning a unique identifier for the provider, defaulting to the class type.
